# Rugs Berber (Cooperative Berber Rugs)

> Cooperative of rural Amazigh (Berber) women weavers in Taznakht, in the Siroua Mountains of Morocco. Authentic handmade, one-of-a-kind Berber rugs in natural wool, sold directly to customers, with worldwide shipping and custom orders.

Each rug is handmade, so every piece is unique and has its own SKU. Prices are listed in USD. Orders are placed via WhatsApp or the checkout (bank transfer).

## Current offer
- Black Friday sale: 30% off all rugs until November 30, 2026.

## Collections (rug styles and techniques)
- [All collections](https://rugsberber.com/collections)
- [Ouaouzguit](https://rugsberber.com/collections/ouaouzguit): hand-knotted, all-wool technique, woolen symbols
- [Glaoui](https://rugsberber.com/collections/glaoui): three techniques (hand-woven, hand-knotted, embroidered), woolen symbols
- [Mouzaïk](https://rugsberber.com/collections/mouzaik): hand-knotted and woven squares, woven and woolen symbols
- [Akhenif](https://rugsberber.com/collections/akhenif): hand-woven technique, woven symbols
- [Tapis Tableau (Lemzerbi)](https://rugsberber.com/collections/tableau): hand-woven technique, woven and woolen symbols
- [Picasso Berber](https://rugsberber.com/collections/picasso): hand-woven technique, woven symbols, double-sided rug
- [Zanifi](https://rugsberber.com/collections/zanifi): hand-embroidered technique, woven and embroidered symbols
- [Runner rugs](https://rugsberber.com/collections/runner): narrow rugs for hallways and corridors, available in the styles above

## Key facts
- Location: Taznakht, Siroua Mountains, Morocco
- Makers: 13 families (3 in Taznakht, 10 in surrounding villages), since 2003
- Material: natural sheep's wool from the Siroua Mountains, natural colors and dyes
- Production time: three weeks to four months per rug
- Ordering and contact: WhatsApp +212 767 149 114
